description: Implementation of utility functions for file handling, UUID generation, timestamp conversion, network requests, image size retrieval, encryption, and widget styling within a Qt-based application.

classes.name: Tools
classes.description: A collection of static utility functions for file operations, network requests, encryption, and UI styling.

methods.name: getFilesPath
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all files in a directory path.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string.

methods.name: getShortUuid
methods.description: Generates a shortened UUID string.

methods.name: timestampFromDateTime
methods.description: Converts a date-time string to a Unix timestamp based on a format.

methods.name: timestampToDateTime
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to a formatted date-time string.

methods.name: readerFileString
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file as a QString.

methods.name: readerFile
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file as a QByteArray.

methods.name: readerFileToList
methods.description: Reads a file and returns its lines as a QStringList.

methods.name: textToStringList
methods.description: Splits a QString into a list of lines.

methods.name: splitNotesData
methods.description: Splits a string into two parts based on a colon delimiter.

methods.name: createShadowEffect
methods.description: Creates a QGraphicsDropShadowEffect with preset parameters.

methods.name: changeWidgetBorder
methods.description: Modifies the border color and width of a QWidget.

methods.name: writerFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file.

methods.name: rowShowCount (QTableWidget)
methods.description: Counts visible (not hidden) rows in a QTableWidget.

methods.name: rowShowCount (QListWidget)
methods.description: Counts visible (not hidden) items in a QListWidget.

methods.name: createMkDir
methods.description: Creates a directory, including parent directories if necessary.

methods.name: urlExists
methods.description: Checks if a URL exists by performing an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: downloadUrlToData
methods.description: Downloads data from a URL using Qt network classes.

methods.name: firstUpperCase
methods.description: Converts the first letter of each word in a string to uppercase.

methods.name: getUsernameByEmail
methods.description: Extracts username part from an email address.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using TinyAES with predefined key and IV.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a string encrypted with TinyAES.

methods.name: qstringToConstData
methods.description: Converts a QString to a const char* data.

methods.name: md5
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a string.

methods.name: getImageSize
methods.description: Retrieves image dimensions from a file path.

methods.name: getImageSize (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves image dimensions from a file name.

methods.name: fileUrlToPath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a filesystem path.

methods.name: fileToBase64
methods.description: Encodes file content to Base64 string.
